# <module dir>:<forbidden module path regexp>
# The module graph of core carries no telemetry, transport, platform client, JsonLogic engine, schema library or other library module.
core:robfig|opentelemetry|prometheus|otelconnect|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|jsonlogic|jsonschema|openfeature-relay/((sync|telemetry|evaluator|configformat|service)/|runtime)
# NFR-005: the embeddable modules are free of telemetry, transport and platform clients down to their module graphs.
evaluator/flagd:opentelemetry|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry)/
configformat/flagd:opentelemetry|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|jsonlogic|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry|evaluator)/
# The file sync provider carries none of the other sync providers, telemetry, transport or platform clients.
sync/file:opentelemetry|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
# gRPC is the transport of sync/flagd-grpc; it carries no other sync provider.
sync/flagd-grpc:openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|http|openfeature-operator|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
# The remaining sync providers carry no other sync provider and no telemetry module. Each cloud provider is on its own
# cloud SDK, so the module graph of one carries none of the other clouds, and none carries gocloud.dev.
sync/http:openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|openfeature-operator|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/openfeature-operator:openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/gcs:github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|gocloud.dev|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/azblob:cloud.google.com/go/storage|github.com/aws|gocloud.dev|google.golang.org/(api|grpc)|googleapis/gax-go|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|gcs|s3|builder))
sync/s3:cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|gocloud.dev|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|gcs|azblob|builder))
sync/sse:go.opentelemetry.io|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
# The Flagsmith sync provider (UC-019) requires the core only: no telemetry SDK, transport or other component module.

# The testbed sync provider (UC-022) requires the core only.
testbed/source:go.opentelemetry.io|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/|evaluator|configformat|service|runtime)
# The telemetry module carries no sync provider and no Kubernetes or gocloud client (OpenTelemetry brings a few Google auth modules).
telemetry/otel:openfeature-relay/sync/|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws

# UC-001 Q7: the service endpoints share their helpers through the transport module and know neither the runtime
# nor one another.
service/transport:openfeature-relay/(runtime|service/(flag-evaluation|ofrep|flag-sync))
service/flag-evaluation:openfeature-relay/(runtime|service/(ofrep|flag-sync))
service/ofrep:openfeature-relay/(runtime|service/(flag-evaluation|flag-sync))
service/flag-sync:openfeature-relay/(runtime|service/(flag-evaluation|ofrep))
# The event collector knows neither the runtime nor another endpoint.
service/event-collector:openfeature-relay/(runtime|service/(flag-evaluation|ofrep|flag-sync))
# UC-007 BR-009 of the engine module: the configuration format example, with its evaluator, needs core only. The tests that
# need flagd are in test/configformat-example/distribution.
test/configformat-example:robfig|opentelemetry|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|open-feature/flagd/flagd|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry|evaluator|configformat)/
# The Builder (UC-001 Q1) depends on no relay module: it only reads manifests and runs the go binary.
builder:open-feature/flagd/|openfeature-relay/(core|runtime|sync|evaluator|configformat|telemetry|service|distribution)
